info.name: Palo Alto Networks IoT Security API
info.description:
REST API for managing IoT and OT device security through Palo Alto Networks IoT Security cloud service. Provides device discovery and profiling, risk assessment, alert management, vulnerability tracking, and policy recommendation capabilities. Enables integration with third-party SIEM, SOAR, CMDB, and NAC platforms for automated security workflows. Requires an active IoT Security subscription.

Contact Support:
 Name: Palo Alto Networks Developer Support
